title: Claude API 429 rate_limit_error
steps: Confirm which limit is hit (requests, input tokens or output tokens per minute) from the error message and rate-limit headers.
Honor the retry-after header; never retry 429s on a fixed short delay.
Reduce concurrency or add client-side token-bucket throttling below the org limit.
Restore prompt caching: cached input tokens generally do not count toward the input-tokens-per-minute limit on current models.
If sustained, route overflow to a fallback model or request a limit increase.

title: Claude API 529 overloaded_error
steps: Check status.anthropic.com for an ongoing capacity event.
Back off exponentially with full jitter; open the circuit breaker after repeated failures.
Fail over to the configured fallback model (for example Sonnet) for non-critical traffic.
Make sure your own retries are not amplifying load (retry storm).

title: Roll back a service deploy
steps: Announce the rollback in the incident channel.
Run the deploy pipeline with the previous version tag.
Verify error rate and latency return to baseline within 10 minutes.

title: Prompt cache hit rate dropped
steps: Compare cache_read_input_tokens before and after the change.
Look for silent invalidators: timestamps or IDs early in the prompt, unsorted JSON, changing tool lists, model switches.
Keep the stable prefix (tools, system) byte-identical; move volatile data to the end of the request.
